title: Screen report flags sessions that reached the upstream fix
body:
Source: S7 screen 2026-11-17: units t-13axy56 and t-11kv38i read the upstream fix; scanner prototype .krn/runs/lead/s7/contam.mjs maps rows to session transcripts by session_id.
